For Ekaterina Karanska it was Never easy….


she started as many of you … being an agent, joined my Coaching and 4 months spent with 0 Deals

Then next 6 months  resulted in AED 1 000 000.00
Her own Commission.
And by the year End she had AED 1 650 000!

But it was just money!

What pushed her to open a first Female owned real estate agency in Saudi Arabia was… a fraud.

The agency she was with - decided to withhold her AED 600 000

That’s really upsetting right?

But she already felt the power of Acting instead Waiting and Blaming!

She first opened a case against her agency 

And second - opened her own agency.

More details in this video - https://lnkd.in/g9GDiZYb
